purpose: Source geometry, collision-backed police planning, single-filter equivalence and exact compiled ROM/ABI evidence. This audit assigns no native gameplay acceptance.

structuredWarnings.message: Passing args to a child process with shell option true can lead to security vulnerabilities, as the arguments are not escaped, only concatenated.

independentAuthoredLanes.checksScope: Named principal roads, exact bounded junction/endcap exceptions, collision sweep, opposing lanes, spawn/heading and final native source tables; meaningful malformed/mutated cases run by default.

preservedContent.northException: Only source-layout and geometry provenance hashes; all actual stop/mission fields canonically pinned.

predecessor.qualification: Source route rejection, not an inherited native jam or collision claim.

semantics.between_nodes: Strict Q4 cardinal interval with exact unchanged lateral coordinate and matching heading; normalized serialized edges have no same-heading overlap.
semantics.chase: Finite iterative local walk; explores at most four graph edges when predecessor edges are <=16px. Chooses actual first edge, then only shortens its longitudinal coordinate toward target; there is no lateral snap.
semantics.return: All supported serialized vertices reach each exact authored role2 target. Every packed return step strictly decreases an independently recomputed weighted potential; between-node heading follows its existing directed edge first.
semantics.caller: Original cached patrol target/leg remain intact during pursuit. Continuous return begins after the current cached cardinal chase segment; waypoint is cleared only at exact original target, then ordinary leg advancement resumes. Actual movement is still committed only by traffic epoch admission/terrain/future-tram guards.
semantics.failure: Public td_police_plan validates district/current scene/Islands/heat/heading/bounds/body/arrived and delegates. td_police_lanes_next publishes only local result after successful sweep, so rejection preserves caller output.

independentPoliceGraph.returnPolicy: All supported vertices reach every exact district role-2 patrol goal; every packed return choice strictly decreases an independently recomputed weighted distance potential.

filterDifferential.sourceChange: One exact origin-coordinate early continue plus comment, authenticated against immutable old source bytes; no other runtime tokens change.
coverage: All 1,148 exact vertices, every local patrol target plus three arbitrary/arrival targets, all four wanted levels and four headings.
Every one of 1,590,927 open Q4 coordinates along all 1,905 directed edges, with rotated valid heat and exact/arbitrary targets.
Seven fractional/start/middle/end positions per edge with complete local target/wanted/heading matrix; signed one-Q4 lateral deviations.

All 256 district, wanted and heading encodings; coordinate/target bounds and rollover encodings; null output, wrong loaded district, solid old body, and blocked long-edge middle after membership proving failed full sweep preserves output.

Both actual public wrappers and unchanged actual td_roads.c execute against registered collision grids; all terrain read order/count, hit markers, result bytes, return flags and guarded failure output compare exactly.
Instrumentation counts membership nodes, all private exit calls and membership-only exit extraction; other chase/return extraction remains equal on every case.
filterDifferential.instrumentationScope: Counters exist only in temporary host copies. Work reduction is not native cycles, frame rate or latency. Node visits and all nonmembership chase/return extraction remain equal per query.

freshByteSpans.name: public-plan-world-bounds-and-body-failures
freshByteSpans.review: All coordinate, already-at-goal and actual road_body-half5 failures reach XOR A;RET at7FCB. Body query is actual bank32:5489. No caller-output writes occur in this function.

freshByteSpans.review: Pushes out2,heading1,target_v2,target_u2,v2,u2,wanted1,district1; calls bank1:776A through stock far wrapper then ADD SP,13;RET. All values retain original order/width.

freshByteSpans.name: caller-actual-waypoint-buffer-and-return-test
freshByteSpans.review: Pushes actual WRAM C30F output pointer, one-byte heading, two-byte targets and actual current u/v, wanted and loaded-view district; invokes bank9:7EFC and discards13args. Failure clears only waypoint.valid C314; success stores from_u/v C315..318, then resets stuck C319. Main caller does not publish an unaccepted road move.

freshByteSpans.name: lane-helper-frame-and-own-input-validation
freshByteSpans.review: ADD SP,-30; district at SP+36, output pointer at SP+47/48. Invalid district/null return only through frame cleanup7C9D. These positions equal the public13-byte BANKED ABI plus30 automatic bytes.

freshByteSpans.name: lane-helper-chase-input-and-return
freshByteSpans.review: Private chase receives current district and vertex through registers, with target_u,target_v and heading passed unchanged on stack. The private callee consumes its five stacked bytes; returned next vertex BC is stored in local SP+10/11.

freshByteSpans.name: lane-helper-full-body-sweep-and-accepted-result-copy
freshByteSpans.review: Converts actual Q4 current/proposed positions to whole pixels, passes four UWORDs plus half5 into road_sweep bank32:5550. False returns without touching out. True constructs u/v/heading/valid in local SP+4..9; loads original out from SP+47/48 into DE and passes length6 with local source BC to fixed memcpy152E. The only caller-output mutation is this six-byte copy after successful sweep.

freshByteSpans.name: output-copy-fixed-routine
freshByteSpans.review: Actual stock memcpy: DE destination and BC source, two-byte length stack argument, count-controlled copies, callee consumes the length. Caller length6 preserves exactly the six-byte ABI and cannot write adjacent bytes.

freshByteSpans.name: private-exit-frame-and-callee-cleanup
freshByteSpans.review: Private exit allocates7 local bytes; source district/index in A/DE are copied to SP+6 and SP+4/5. Choice is stacked at SP+9.

freshByteSpans.name: private-exit-cleanup
freshByteSpans.review: ADD SP,7;POP HL;INC SP;JP HL restores seven locals, consumes one stacked choice and returns through saved address.

freshByteSpans.name: chase-automatic-frame
freshByteSpans.review: Private iterative chase allocates32 automatic bytes. It is not recursive. Stack-resident path[4]/choices[4] have bounded depth0..3.

freshByteSpans.name: chase-depth-bound
freshByteSpans.review: Unsigned depth compared to3 and skips descent when >=3; outgoing-corner lookahead remains finite4edges.

freshByteSpans.name: chase-cleanup
freshByteSpans.review: ADD SP,32;POP HL;ADD SP,5;JP HL restores locals and five stacked inputs. It returns selected index BC.

freshByteSpans.name: projection-frame
freshByteSpans.review: Private projection allocates4 automatic bytes and stores the register-origin coordinate; destination pointers are caller automatic WRAM.

freshByteSpans.name: projection-cleanup
freshByteSpans.review: ADD SP,4;POP HL;ADD SP,8;JP HL restores its own locals and consumes eight stacked arguments. No persistent scratch state.

freshByteSpans.name: stock-far-call-bank-restoration
freshByteSpans.review: Saves current ROM bank from HRAM90, switches to target bank E, invokes RST20, restores saved bank to HRAM/MBC, returns result through A. Nested public/helper/roads calls restore the owning bank.

freshByteSpans.name: unrelated-node-alignment-filter
freshByteSpans.review: Compares both16-bit current axes with origin axes: B=equal_u,C=equal_v. BIT0,B accepts equal_u; otherwise BIT0,C; when neither matches JP Z,7B0D advancesindex without directed-exit lookup. Exactnode acceptance requires bothB/C true and enters original branch. An aligned edge retains originalheading/between validation.

freshByteSpans.name: filter-skipped-node-loop-advance
freshByteSpans.review: Original node increment atSP+27/28 updates index atSP+18/19 and jumps to78DC count bound. Filter does not mutate coordinates, output or waypoint; it only omits ineligibleorigin exits.

freshByteSpans.name: current-district-query-relocation
freshByteSpans.review: Fresh public planner calls actual NOI td_district_current atbank25:7D0A; its onlythree changed bytes vs initial publicplanner are relocated bank/low/high operands. Validation/output ABI remains unchanged.

manualTrace.fullSweepAndOutput: The planner's sole accepted output store copies exactly six bytes to caller WRAM after the real half-5 road sweep succeeds; planner rejection preserves out. TORONTO explicitly clears only waypoint.valid after rejection. Successful planning alone does not publish movement: real traffic/light/courier/future-tram admission must still pass before committing position.
manualTrace.farCallRestoration: Exact stock wrapper saves/restores the owning ROM bank around public/helper/road calls; same-unit const graph pointers remain valid on return.
manualTrace.neighborWrites: Fresh compiled argument, output pointer, bounded copy and private state stores are inspected against the matching NOI; no prior instruction addresses are inherited.

limitations: This is source, host-equivalence and static compiled-byte evidence only. Native gameplay, timing and loading acceptance remain separate.
Pursuit uses bounded local lookahead; it is not a whole-city shortest path, universally terminating chase or proof of capture from every position.
Only graph fragments that can legally return to every patrol target are supported; coverage is not asserted for every traversable road.
Synthetic 94.800164% membership-exit work reduction does not establish a native speedup, frame rate, input latency or whole-city performance.
One-byte helper-bank and ten-byte main-bank headroom leave little room for edits; every subsequent build needs its own capacity/source/ABI audit.
The 1,096-byte linked static reserve and decoded 30/32/7/4-byte local frames do not prove deepest runtime stack high-water.
Use this artifact's relocated stock WRAM addresses for reads. Unchanged game-owned fields do not imply all WRAM addresses stayed unchanged.
No all-104-campaign, two human hours, browser usability, streamed-console or physical cartridge boot claim is assigned here.
